title: McCoy Federal Building Fire Alarm Replacement - Jackson, MS
description:
The General Services Administration, Public Building Service is seeking a Mississippi licensed fire alarm contractor to furnish all labor, tools, materials, equipment, supplies and supervision for the complete replacement of the existing fire alarm system with a new networked nodal Fire Emergency Voice/Alarm Communication System. 

 For a firm to qualify for award of this project, the contractor must meet the following qualifications: 

 1. Past Experience - The Contractor shall have successfully completed 3 projects installing a fire alarm system/emergency voice alarm in an occupied building with a construction value of $1,000,000.00.  

 2. Key Personnel - Project personnel shall meet the below installer qualifications: 

 - Fire Alarm Systems Designer - must be NICET Level IV and currently certified on the system by the fire alarm control equipment manufacturer. Must hold APS license in Mississippi with 5 years experience designing fire alarms. The NICET IV must be employed by the Prime Contractor for a minimum of 2 years. 
- Fire Alarm Systems Technician - must be NICET Level III and currently certified on the system by the fire alarm control equipment manufacturer. Must have 3 years of supervision, installation, adjustments, and test of fire alarm system. 

 3. Equipment Qualifications - the equipment must be provided from a manufacturer that licenses a minimum of three independent Fire Alarm installation contractors as Authorized Distributors of their brand of fire alarm products within 250 miles of the project site. All equipment and components shall be new and of the same manufacturer, brand and current model. The following manufacturers/brands are known to meet the above requirements: 1) Siemens Building Technologies 2) EST 3) Notifier 
It is anticipated that this project will take approximately 365 days for construction. Please note that there is no solicitation at this time; the purpose of this announcement is to identify available sources only. Award of any resulting procurement will be based on a source selection employing a “Best Value Concept” methodology. 

 Firms interested in this opportunity should send the following in email to Kevin.Mack@gsa.gov: 

 1. What Manufacturer/Brand fire alarm system are you an Authorized Distributor of? 
2. Statement regarding bonding capabilities. 
3. Indicate if your company is a small business and the socio-economic status if any. 
4. All interested firms will be required to register in the Government’s System for Award Management (SAM)-www.sam.gov. Prior Government work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought synopsis. However, all design and construction for this project shall be required to adhere to the Scope of Work and all Federal, State and Local ordinances.
